an10.68:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Naḷakapāne viharati Palāsavane.
an10.68:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadah' uposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an10.68:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā bahu-d-eva rattiṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi
an10.68:2.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.68:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā catuguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā. 2.
an10.68:3.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.68:3.4: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.68:4.1: Yassa kassaci āvuso saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi . . .
an10.68:4.9: appamādo natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
an10.68:4.10: Seyyathā pi āvuso kālapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāyat' eva vaṇṇena, hāyati maṇḍalena, hāyati ābhāya, hāyati ārohapariṇāhena:
an10.68:4.11: evam eva kho āvuso yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi . . .
an10.68:4.19: appamādo natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi. 4.
an10.68:5.1: Yassa kassaci āvuso saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri atthi . . .
an10.68:5.9: appamādo atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
an10.68:5.10: Seyyathā pi āvuso juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vaḍḍhat' eva vaṇṇena, vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena, vaḍḍhati ābhāya, vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena:
an10.68:5.11: evam eva kho āvuso yassa kassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri atthi . . . ottappaṃ atthi . . . viriyaṃ atthi . . . paññā atthi . . . sotāvadhānaṃ atthi . . . dhammadhāraṇā atthi . . . atthupaparikkhā atthi . . . dhammānudhammapaṭipatti atthi . . .
an10.68:5.12: appamādo atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānī ti. 5.
